issue_needs_context_not_application_targ.text: Whether the lower-court finding that the petitioner sublet the premises connects to the section 14(1)(b) conduct element of subletting, assignment, or other parting with possession.
Whether the relevant subletting or other transfer occurred without the landlord's written consent, including whether any supplied Delhi consent or notice provision connects to the case.
Whether the conduct underlying the eviction petition falls within the supplied statutory date scope, including the on-or-after 9 June 1952 requirement.
Whether the tenant's contention that there was no positive finding of consideration paid by the alleged sub-tenants affects the fixed section 14(1)(b) ground.
